text:
Protection | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the testing procedure P1, which must be performed on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block
These relays are of induction disk type, for protection of apparatus against 
the effect of over frequency or under frequency. These relays are used to make 
on alarm and raise a target, They have two contacts. The left contact 
closes on under frequency and the right contact closes on over frequency.
The 
first draft initiated by eng. Fayza El-Sharkawy, tested by eng. Shirin Hamdy, 
eng. Azza Salama at 29 April 2003, revised by EDEPC quality control Eng. Adel El-Nagar, accepted by General Director 
eng. Mahmoud Saker and approved by eng. Moustfa 
Alam Head Sector of Talkha Power Station.
Safety Precautions
The 
 generator must be out of service.
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category,
Maintenance 
 staff should be trained well, qualified or directly supervised by some one 
 who is.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Personal
 safety and healthy equipment must be used as safety shoes, safety helmet ... 
 etc
The 
 generator must be out of service.
Tools and Equipment
Work to be Carried Out
Preparation
Make Sure P.T secondary circuit are opened at the incoming terminal 
 blocks before isolating
 the relay voltage circuit for test
Look at field maintenance file and compare the position of the setting 
switches on relay with those shown on the test sheet .

Low ( Under ) Frequency Test
Connect the relay studs ( 5 6 ) to voltage terminal by the test leads.
Increase the voltage to 115 v.
Adjust the frequency to the normal value.
Decrease the frequency slowly until the left target ( flag ) appears .
Record the frequency value and the time value at which the flag appears in the 
test sheet .
Connect the relay studs ( 5 6 ) to voltage terminal by the test leads.
Increase the voltage to 115 v.
Adjust the frequency to the normal value.
Decrease the frequency slowly until the left target ( flag ) appears .
Record the frequency value and the time value at which the flag appears in the 
test sheet .
High ( Over ) Frequency 
 Test
Connect the relay studs ( 7 , 8 ) to the voltage terminal by the test 
 leads .
Repeat the steps ( 3 
, 4 ).
Increase the frequency slowly until the right target appears.
Record the frequency value and the time value at which the flag a pears 
in the test sheet.
Connect the relay studs ( 7 , 8 ) to the voltage terminal by the test 
 leads .
Repeat the steps ( 3 
, 4 ).
Increase the frequency slowly until the right target appears.
Record the frequency value and the time value at which the flag a pears 
in the test sheet.
Return Relay and Associated Equipment to 
Service
Return relay to service by removing the 
 test leads from the relay terminal block and the test set i.e.
 - Disconnect the test leads from the terminals ( 7-8 )
 - Disconnect the test leads between the trip contact ( 1 - 2 )
Make sure CT and PT secondary circuits 
 are in normal condition.
If any equipment associated with the 
 relay has been isolated, it should be returned to service by the following 
 restoration steps:
 - Breaker trip coils.
 - Breaker failure scheme associated this relay.
 - Disturbance alarm and fault recorder associated with this relay.

sections_ar.text: إعادة جهاز الوقاية والمعدات المرتبطة به إلى الخدمة

items: أعد الريلاي إلى الخدمة بإزالة أسلاك الاختبار من روزتة أطراف الريلاي ومن جهاز الاختبار، أي: - افصل أسلاك الاختبار عن الطرفين (7-8) - افصل أسلاك الاختبار بين تلامس الفصل (1 - 2)
تأكد من أن دوائر ثانوي محول التيار ومحول الجهد في الحالة الطبيعية.

إذا تم عزل أي معدة مرتبطة بالريلاي، فيجب إعادتها إلى الخدمة باتباع خطوات الإعادة التالية: - ملفات فصل القاطع. - منظومة فشل القاطع المرتبطة بهذا الريلاي. - إنذار الاضطراب ومسجل الأعطال المرتبطان بهذا الريلاي.
